VCT 2026Player Cards

How ratings work

Overall

OVR is 85% the player's own role-relative performance (plus IGL credit) and 15% team results. It sits on a fixed scale: the average VCT player is 77, and one standard deviation is 8 points. No rating was hand-tuned. Base cards cap at 97.

Role-relative means each player is compared to others in the same role, across about 220 VCT players. Small samples are pulled toward average.

Roles

Roles come from agent usage across the year: 60% or more on one role gives that role, otherwise FLEX. A few roles were corrected by hand where the usage misleads (Neon FLEX, Sato and spike DUEL, kiNgg and erde CTRL).

Viper counts as a Sentinel. Chamber is split half Duelist, half Sentinel, since duelist-style Operator players run him.

Ratings compare each player to others in the same role.

Team results

  • Kickoff1
  • Santiago3
  • Stage 11.5
  • London3.5
  • Stage 22
  • Shanghai4

Placements are weighted by event, and London counts a little more than Santiago because it is later. Stats use the same weights, multiplied by rounds played. Missing an international event counts against a team.

Region strength

Regional-league stats (Kickoff, Stage 1, Stage 2) are discounted by region, based on how much each region's players' ratings dropped at internationals this year: Americas 0 (the reference), EMEA −2%, Pacific −2.6%, China −13% (measured across 32 Chinese players with international maps).

International stats are not adjusted. Card backs show raw VLR numbers.

IGLs

IGLs get a bonus from about +1 to +3 OVR. Everyone gets some credit for shotcalling. More goes to IGLs whose teams finished better than their players' individual stats predicted (Rb, erde and f0rsakeN are at the top). Teams that underperformed their talent get the minimum.

The IGL list is from roster trackers and may miss mid-season changes.

Special cards

Winner cards (Masters, Champions) are 60% that event's performance and 40% season OVR, with no extra boost, since the win already counts through the placement. The event part uses the same formula, fed only with that event's stats and placement. MVP cards are 99.

2027 rosters

The 2027 section shows offseason rosters from vlr.gg team pages and transfer reports. Ratings are carried over from 2026. Players with no VCT stats are shown as new and unrated.

Returning players without 2026 VCT league games are rated from their 2024–25 VCT stats with the same formula, a neutral team score, and a discount for older data (x0.85 if they last played in 2025, x0.5 if 2024). Their cards say which years the stats come from.

2026 games for play-in and qualifier teams count too, discounted 8% for the weaker field and shrunk harder toward average for small samples.

Tags

Rookie means no VCT partner-league or international maps in 2024 or 2025. Dropped players were replaced during the season (including a sixth man who lost his spot in the final event) and are hidden unless you turn them on.

Tiers

Card colour follows OVR: 90+, 80+, 70+ and 60+ each have their own finish.
